0022600131.text: The Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, 4th in the West) in the fourth game of Los Angeles's 2026-27 season, and the Lakers are 2-0 at home and 1-0 on the road. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), while Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and has Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. This season's series has no games yet, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost the series 1-2, including a 132-116 loss in Portland on January 17, 2026.
